description: This file defines a React functional component named Navbar. The component renders a navigation bar with app branding, navigation links, and authentication-related actions (Login/Logout). It utilizes React Router's NavLink and Link components for routing, and consumes an AuthContext to manage user authentication state. The Navbar adjusts its display based on whether a user is authenticated, providing navigation to dashboard, leave application, leave balance, and admin pages.

methods.name: Navbar()
methods.description: React functional component that renders the navigation bar with branding, links, and auth actions.

methods.name: handleLogout
methods.description: Asynchronous function that signs out the user and redirects to the login page. Handles errors silently.
